Rogue Venom Bow resource attribution
====================================

The Rogue Venom Bow's first-person animation, projectile frames, draw/fire/hit/
reload sounds, and three-shot-magazine concept are adapted from the slot-9
Silent Stormbow in the user-supplied Doom_Deluxe_Beta1.pk3. TuinRPG supplies
its own Rogue-only weapon rules, dedicated ammunition, stacking poison system,
pickup artwork, balance, and RPG integration. The original alt-fire and Doom
Deluxe player/framework dependencies are not included.

Doom Deluxe team credit: Dox778, Jade, Wocht11K, Machinegun Cow,
Generic Name Guy, TommyGalano5, Squig, and JijaDoubleShotgun (Rick).

The supplied Doom Deluxe credits identify the crossbow sprite contributors as
Lippeth, ravage, Xaser, TommyGalano5, Wocht11k, and Machinegun Cow. Crossbow
sound mixing is credited to Squig.
